title: Broker not creating execution records for proxied requests
description: When the agent executes a proxied request through the broker using 'jentic execute', the request successfully reaches the target API but no execution record is created in the platform database. This breaks audit trails and execution tracking.
reproduction_steps: Request and receive toolkit binding for an API
Execute 'jentic execute <operation_id>' for a valid operation
Observe CLI reports success and target API receives request
Query platform database for execution records
Observe 0 execution records despite successful API calls
expected_behavior: Each proxied request through the broker should create an execution record in the platform database for audit and tracking purposes.
actual_behavior: Requests are successfully proxied to the target API (31 requests logged at test API) but 0 execution records appear in the platform database.
evidence: [bug] task=make-proxied-request | Agent narration reports successful proxied request, but verification shows 0 execution records in platform database despite test API receiving 31 requests

[blocker] task=make-proxied-request | Critical discrepancy: test API logs confirm requests arrived, but execution tracking system shows no records—suggests broker may not be creating execution records or using alternate execution path
task=make-proxied-request | Agent executed 'jentic execute get_test_data' which reached test API (31 requests logged)

title: API discovery verification shows no GET request to /apis endpoint despite agent claiming success
description: Agent narration indicates successful API discovery using 'jentic apis' commands, but platform logs show no GET request was made to the /apis/jentic-test endpoint, suggesting either the CLI is not hitting the expected control plane endpoint or logging is incomplete.
reproduction_steps: Check control plane logs for GET requests to /apis/* endpoints
Observe discrepancy between CLI success and logged requests
expected_behavior: When agent uses 'jentic apis' commands, corresponding GET requests should be logged in the control plane at /apis endpoints.
actual_behavior: Agent successfully retrieves API information via CLI but no corresponding GET request to /apis/jentic-test is logged in control plane.
evidence: [bug] task=find-credential | Agent narration claims successful API discovery, but verification shows no GET request to /apis/jentic-test endpoint was logged in control plane
task=find-credential | Agent used 'jentic apis list' and 'jentic apis show' to locate test API and view operation details
